The test image shows a dark green tomato leaf with many small, discrete, reddish-brown spots scattered uniformly across the surface - no large necrotic areas, no concentric rings, no mold, no yellowing. This pattern most closely matches Septoria_Leaf_Blotch (first reference, CDDM_1928), which showed similar-sized circular spots on a dark green intact leaf.
